FAQ

Do I need a credit card to sign up?

No. The free plan works without a card. A card is only needed when upgrading to a paid plan.

How does the AI assistant work?

Upload your texts, files or links to the knowledge base - the assistant answers visitors from them and hands hard questions to an operator. Available on Start and Business.

What is the 30-day money-back guarantee?

Within 30 days of your first payment for a paid plan we refund on request. Terms are in the public offer.

Can I customize the widget to match my brand?

Yes: colours, button position and style, logo, greeting texts. On Start and Business - without the Prochat logo.

Is there support in Uzbek?

Yes. A customer writes in Uzbek or Russian - the operator and the AI assistant reply in their language. Our team answers in both languages too.
